## UI-03: Ecosystem Compatibility

**Figma frame:** _Ecosystem Compatibility_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design
**Complexity:** Medium (150 points)
**Estimated time:** 2 to 3 days

> 🎨 **Design-only issue** — you work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (styles), UI-20 (grid). Use styles/grid.

---

### Context

Directly under the hero, this band reassures visitors that `use-stellar` fits the
stack they already use — React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, the Stellar SDK,
Horizon, Soroban, and the supported wallets. It's a trust strip of logos + labels.

---

### Why this matters

"Does this work with my setup?" is the first objection. Showing the ecosystem
logos up front answers it instantly.

---

### What to design (in Figma)

- A row/grid of ecosystem logos with labels exactly as in the frame.
- Consistent **optical** sizing (not raw file size), evenly spaced and centered on
  the UI-20 grid.
- Logos grayscale/muted or brand-colored per the frame.
- Optional short heading ("Works with your stack") per the frame.
- Source the logos as proper vector marks and keep the layer set tidy.

---

### Deliverables

- Desktop logo band + a mobile (wrapped) version.

---

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All ecosystem logos from the frame present, evenly aligned, optically sized
- [ ] Logos are clean vectors; layers named
- [ ] Aligned to UI-20 grid; colors/text from UI-17 — no loose hex
- [ ] Mobile wrap designed
- [ ] Frame shared for review; `Closes #[issue number]`
- [ ] **Your PR targets the `dev` branch** — work pushed to `main` (or any
      branch other than `dev`) will **not** be merged
- [ ] ⭐ Leave a star on the project — it is small, free, and very much
      appreciated
